name: the-declarations-of-a-recipe-stay-inside-it
query: :number/m (:y 5; add 1 | add y); get [(1 | m) (::host | env | has :y)]

name: a-recipe-carries-the-values-of-its-text-it-reads
query: apply (:n 3; :number/times mul n; 5 | times)

name: a-verb-recurses-through-the-tree
query: :number/fact (if (lte 1) (1) (mul (sub 1 | fact))); 5 | fact

name: a-value-the-text-names-reaches-no-selector-of-a-verb
query: apply (:it 5; 3 | is ::number)

name: a-value-the-text-names-reaches-no-invariant-of-a-verb
query: apply (:floor 3; [1 2 3] | drop 1)

name: a-recipe-reads-the-values-of-its-text-and-none-of-its-call
query: apply (:k 1; :number/f add k; :any/g (::fn | takes :k |~~ The k. ~~| /0 | impl ~(5 | f)); g 100)

name: a-recipe-of-a-function-reads-its-input-past-a-value-of-the-text
query: apply (:by 99; :number/plus (::fn | takes :by |~~ How much. ~~| /0 | impl ~(add by)); 5 | plus 3)

name: a-value-of-the-text-shadows-no-verb-the-recipe-of-a-function-calls
query: apply (:twice 7; :number/plus (::fn | takes :by |~~ How much. ~~| /0 | impl ~(add by | twice)); :number/twice mul 2; 5 | plus 1)

name: a-recipe-reads-no-quote-its-query-names
query: apply (:x 10; :q ~(add x); :any/t (::fn | takes :x |~~ The x. ~~| /0 | impl ~(apply q)); 2 | t 99 !| get [tag name])

name: a-quote-written-in-its-step-reads-that-step
query: :vec/addAll (::fn | takes :by |~~ The by. ~~| /0 | impl ~(map (add by))); [1 2] | addAll 10

name: a-recipe-of-a-function-reads-a-verb-declared-after-it
query: :number/plus (::fn | takes :by |~~ How much. ~~| /0 | impl ~(add by | twice)); :number/twice mul 2; 5 | plus 1

name: a-verb-reads-its-input-by-its-name
query: :number/m (::fn | takes :x |~~ The x. ~~| /0 | impl ~(mul 10 | add x)); 2 | m it

name: a-verb-recurses-through-its-input
query: :number/fact (::fn | takes :n |~~ The n. ~~| /0 ::number | impl ~(if (n | lte 1) (1) (n | mul (fact (n | sub 1))))); 5 | fact it

name: a-recipe-under-a-label-reads-no-input-of-the-verb-it-shadows
query: :Box |~~ B ~~|; :Box/take ~([7 8 9] | count); ::Box[1 2 3] | take

name: a-declared-verb-recurses-with-its-input-of-code
query: :map/treeMap (::fn | takes :fn |~~ The fn. ~~| /0 ::quote | impl ~(get {:label (get /label | apply fn) :children (get /children | map (treeMap fn))})); {:label "a" :children [{:label "b" :children []}]} | treeMap (append "!") | get /label

name: fractal-composition-three-levels
query: :vec/topBy (::fn | takes :keyFn |~~ The keyFn. ~~| /0 | takes :n |~~ The n. ~~| /1 ::number | holds :KeyFnNotCodeError |~~ Code. ~~| ~(keyFn | is ::quote ::path) | impl ~(sort keyFn | reverse | take n)); :vec/topNByV (::fn | takes :n |~~ The n. ~~| /0 ::number | impl ~(topBy /v n)); :vec/top2ByV topNByV 2; [{:v 10} {:v 30} {:v 20}] | top2ByV | map /v

name: a-verb-of-no-inputs-reads-its-args
query: :any/n (args | count); 5 | n

name: a-recipe-written-alone-refuses-the-args-given-to-it
query: :any/n (args | count); 5 | n 1 !| tag

name: a-recipe-under-a-closed-label-sees-the-names-of-its-wiring
query: :Card |~~ A card. ~~| (::kind | accepts |~~ The parts. ~~| ::vec | wires :took |~~ The seconds. ~~| /1 ::number); :Card/minutes (took | div 60 | floor); ::Card["a" 312] | minutes

name: an-input-named-as-a-part-of-the-wiring-of-its-label-is-refused
query: ~(:Card |~~ A card. ~~| (::kind | accepts |~~ The parts. ~~| ::vec | wires :took |~~ The seconds. ~~| /1 ::number); :Card/plus (::fn | takes :took |~~ x ~~| /0 | impl ~(took))) | answer !| get [tag name]

name: a-verb-under-a-label-is-declared-by-its-program
query: :number/twice mul 2; 5 | twice

name: a-quote-under-a-label-is-refused-naming-its-program
query: ~(:number/twice ~(mul 2); 5 | twice) | answer !| tag
